setup.title: Build your clean-air plan
setup.subtitle: Five short steps. Everything stays on this device.
setup.complete: Your plan is ready. You can edit any step later.
setup.resume: You have an unfinished plan. Pick up where you left off.
setup.regionWhy: Air standards and sunrise times differ by place. We use the region, never your exact address.
setup.locateDenied: Location was not shared. Pick a region instead.
setup.householdWhy: Children, older adults and people with breathing or heart conditions need different guidance.
setup.memberHelp: Counts only. No names are stored or sent.
setup.homeWhy: Room size, windows and cooking fuel change how much smoke stays indoors.
setup.mobilityWhy: Short trips and school runs are often the easiest emissions to cut.
setup.budgetTitle: What can you spend and spare?
setup.budgetWhy: We put free options first when money or time is tight.

home.myth1q: Does a candle clean the air?
home.myth1a: No. Burning candles adds particles. Ventilate at a cleaner time instead.
home.myth2q: Do indoor plants purify a room?
home.myth2a: Not at realistic room scale. Use a correctly sized purifier or cleaner outdoor air.

settings.title: Settings and privacy
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete all data stored on this device?
settings.privacyBody: Only a chat question and a summary of your plan. No air data is fetched, no location is sent, and nothing is stored on a server. Service workers cache this app's static files only.
settings.badImport: That file is too large or is not a valid Almanair export.

receipt.title: Impact receipt
receipt.envelope: The range is an envelope of low and high inputs, not a statistical interval.
receipt.formulaIndoor: Indoor air = (penetration × exchange × outdoor + sources ÷ volume) ÷ (exchange + deposition + clean air rate ÷ volume)
receipt.formulaDose: Each hour: concentration × breathing rate × one hour. The range combines low and high inputs.
receipt.formulaCarbon: Activity amount × published CO2e factor × seven days

guidance.general0: Air is clear. Keep an eye on changes if someone is sensitive.
guidance.general1: Air is acceptable. Sensitive people can shorten very long outdoor sessions.
guidance.general2: Sensitive people should take lighter breaks outdoors. Keep windows short.
guidance.general3: Limit outdoor exertion. Keep windows closed at peak times and use a purifier if you have one.
guidance.general4: Keep everyone indoors during peak hours. Use a clean-air room and well-fitting masks if you must go out.
guidance.general5: Stay indoors in a clean-air room. Follow local emergency advice.
guidance.vulnerable1: Watch for symptoms and keep medicines close.
guidance.vulnerable2: Choose indoor play and move exercise to cleaner hours.
guidance.vulnerable3: Avoid outdoor exertion. Seek care if breathing becomes difficult.
guidance.vulnerable4: Stay in a filtered room and contact your care team for a plan.
guidance.vulnerable5: Follow emergency guidance and seek medical help for severe symptoms.

shortWindows.title: Open windows for the cleaner window
shortWindows.detail: Air the home only when outdoor air dips below indoor air.
shortWindows.why: Fresh air without the smoke peak.

cookHood.title: Cook on the back burner with a fan out
cookHood.detail: Use a lid and vent cooking fumes outside where safe.
cookHood.why: Cooking is a large indoor particle source.

cleanRoom.title: Make one clean-air room
cleanRoom.detail: Close one room and run a correctly sized purifier there.
cleanRoom.why: A smaller space is easier to clean.

dampWipe.title: Damp-wipe surfaces
dampWipe.detail: Wet cloths trap settled dust instead of lifting it.

noIndoorBurn.title: Move cooking outdoors or to a flue
noIndoorBurn.detail: Avoid burning biomass or kerosene inside the living space.

walkShort.title: Walk short local trips
walkShort.detail: Replace one short car trip with walking at a cleaner hour.
walkShort.why: No tailpipe emissions and more movement.

busSchool.title: Share a bus ride to school
busSchool.detail: Combine school runs into one shared trip.

bikeErrands.title: Bike the short errand
bikeErrands.detail: Use a bicycle when the air band allows it.

switchElectric.title: Switch to electric cooking when possible
switchElectric.detail: Plan the change around your tenure and budget.

sealGaps.title: Seal window and door gaps
sealGaps.detail: Use removable draft strips in rented homes.

pledge.title: Join a neighbourhood pledge
pledge.detail: Share one change with your community.

wasteSeparate.title: Keep waste out of open burning
wasteSeparate.detail: Separate dry waste and hand it to a collection point.
